Compose file JSON schemas, one per supported compose release: the oldest (the floor) and the newest.
Each is the schema of the compose-go module version that release's go.mod pins, fetched unmodified.

  go.mod line:     github.com/compose-spec/compose-go/v2 v2.2.0
  source:          https://raw.githubusercontent.com/compose-spec/compose-go/v2.2.0/schema/compose-spec.json
  sha256:          8535b9c0af36065c6200c230adc8e6301a6afe7a72dd5004464346625bc928c1
  fetched:         2026-09-24
